content.json:
# Hosted agents gateway audit workbook
Start with the overview charts, then use the evidence sections below. The time range applies to every section; the trace ID filters only **Trace investigation**.

Empty results are not proof of a passing control. Gateway and hosted-agent tokens are overlapping observations: do not sum them together. **Privacy:** message and tool-content panels contain potentially sensitive data; use approved demo data and workspace RBAC.

## Overview - token usage
**Selected range: {TimeRange:label} ({TimeRange:start} to {TimeRange:end}); bucket: {TimeRange:grain}.** The left chart compares gateway lanes; the right chart shows hosted-agent **chat** spans separately. **AI Gateway - Foundry-observed** uses real backend token counters matched to the gateway's managed identity, not the native tier request-log counters (which can incorrectly report zero). Missing native token telemetry remains unavailable; this does not establish native metric export or token-limit enforcement. Input and output are distinct series. They describe overlapping work, not additional consumption. Empty buckets within an observed series are zero-filled across the selected window; a window with no token observations shows the no-data message, not fabricated series. The trace input below does not filter these charts.

content.noDataMessage: No gateway LLM token observations in this time range. For AI Gateway, verify the bound managed-identity principal ID and Foundry RequestResponse diagnostics; make a model request and allow for ingestion delay.
content.title: Gateway LLM tokens - APIM vs AI Gateway tier

content.noDataMessage: No hosted-agent chat token telemetry in this time range. Direct gateway calls do not create hosted-agent spans.
content.title: Hosted-agent chat tokens - separate observation layer

content.json:
## Token usage details
Use these tables to inspect the source, recorded identity/model, routes and request counts behind the overview. **Foundry-observed** tier tokens are attributed to the gateway managed identity, not to a human/agent behind its shared runtime key. Query 11 retains separate **llm-request** rows with null token counts to expose the native-export gap; do not add those request observations to backend observations. Agent names are not application IDs. Missing identity binding or backend diagnostics means unavailable attribution, not zero usage.

content.title: 02 - Token usage by telemetry source and recorded identity/model
11 - APIM, AI Gateway tier and hosted-agent observations (not additive)

content.json:
## Gateway health and tool activity
Latency, HTTP failures, tool decisions and MCP methods/sessions across the selected time range. Identity and token joins are best-effort evidence, not inferred links.

content.query: union isfuzzy=true (datatable(TimeGenerated:datetime, Gateway:string, Route:string, Duration:real, Status:int)[]), (ApiManagementGatewayLogs | project TimeGenerated, Gateway='apim-v2', Route=ApiId, Duration=todouble(TotalTime), Status=toint(ResponseCode)), (AppRequests | where AppRoleName startswith 'aigw-' | project TimeGenerated, Gateway='aigateway-tier', Route=Name, Duration=DurationMs, Status=toint(ResultCode)) | summarize Requests=count(), P95DurationMs=percentile(Duration, 95), Failures5xx=countif(Status between (500 .. 599)) by bin(TimeGenerated, 15m), Gateway, Route | order by TimeGenerated desc | take 200
content.title: Gateway latency (milliseconds) and HTTP 5xx
01 - Who called which tool: audit and best-effort gateway/token joins
05 - MCP methods, tools, servers and sessions

content.json:
## Security and platform audit
Inspect denials, content-safety signals, identity events and resource changes. Entra and Activity Log exports are opt-in; no rows means no evidence in this range, not a passing control.

content.title: 09 - Content-safety signals (inspect evidence, not a policy proof)
07 - Entra identity sign-ins and agent audit (requires export)
10 - Foundry audit and application trace events

content.query: union isfuzzy=true (datatable(TimeGenerated:datetime, Source:string, Operation:string, Status:string, ResourceId:string, Detail:string)[]), (AzureDiagnostics | where ResourceProvider in~ ('MICROSOFT.KEYVAULT', 'MICROSOFT.CONTAINERREGISTRY') | project TimeGenerated, Source=ResourceProvider, Operation=OperationName, Status=ResultType, ResourceId, Detail=ResultDescription), (ContainerRegistryLoginEvents | project TimeGenerated, Source='ContainerRegistryLoginEvents', Operation=tostring(column_ifexists('OperationName', '')), Status=tostring(column_ifexists('ResultType', '')), ResourceId=tostring(column_ifexists('_ResourceId', '')), Detail=tostring(column_ifexists('ResultDescription', ''))), (ContainerRegistryRepositoryEvents | project TimeGenerated, Source='ContainerRegistryRepositoryEvents', Operation=tostring(column_ifexists('OperationName', '')), Status=tostring(column_ifexists('ResultType', '')), ResourceId=tostring(column_ifexists('_ResourceId', '')), Detail=tostring(column_ifexists('ResultDescription', ''))) | order by TimeGenerated desc | take 100
content.title: Key Vault and container registry audit events

content.json:
## Trace investigation
The optional input in this section filters **only** the timeline and hosted-agent content below. Leave it blank for recent hops. The timeline accepts a W3C trace ID or an APIM correlation ID; hosted-agent content matches W3C trace IDs only and can be empty for an APIM correlation ID.

APIM's `OperationId` is an API operation name, not a W3C trace ID. Gateway rows can link through an actual tool audit record's `gateway_request_id`; absent links remain missing evidence. This input does not filter the overview, audit tables, telemetry coverage or APIM message sample.

parameters.name: traceId
parameters.label: Trace / APIM correlation ID (this section only)

content.query: union isfuzzy=true (datatable(TimeGenerated:datetime, TraceId:string, AgentName:string, AgentId:string, ModelName:string, InputMessages:string, OutputMessages:string, ToolCallArguments:string, ToolCallResult:string)[]), (AppGenAIContent | project TimeGenerated, TraceId, AgentName, AgentId, ModelName, InputMessages, OutputMessages, ToolCallArguments, ToolCallResult) | where isempty("{traceId:escapejson}") or TraceId == "{traceId:escapejson}" | order by TimeGenerated desc | take 50
content.title: Hosted-agent content and tool arguments/results (sensitive content)

content.json:
## APIM message sample
Prompts and completions across the selected **time range**, not the trace input above. This table can contain sensitive content. Use a returned `CorrelationId` in Trace investigation to examine that gateway request.

## Telemetry coverage
Sources with ingested rows in the selected time range. An absent source is not proof that its diagnostic setting is enabled or disabled. Check export settings and ingestion delay when expected evidence is missing.

content.query: union isfuzzy=true withsource=SourceTable (datatable(TimeGenerated:datetime)[]), ApiManagementGatewayLogs, ApiManagementGatewayLlmLog, ApiManagementGatewayMCPLog, AppRequests, AppDependencies, AppTraces, AppGenAIContent, ContainerAppConsoleLogs_CL, AADServicePrincipalSignInLogs, AADManagedIdentitySignInLogs, AuditLogs, AzureActivity, AzureDiagnostics, ContainerRegistryLoginEvents, ContainerRegistryRepositoryEvents | summarize Rows=count(), Latest=max(TimeGenerated) by SourceTable | order by SourceTable asc
content.title: Telemetry sources with rows in the selected time range
